title: Penalty-Based Smoothing of Convex Nonsmooth Supremum Functions with Accelerated Inertial Dynamics
summary: We propose a penalty-based smoothing framework for convex nonsmooth functions with a supremum structure. The regularization yields a differentiable surrogate with controlled approximation error, a single-valued dual maximizer, and explicit gradient formulas. We then study an accelerated inertial dynamic with vanishing damping driven by a time-dependent regularized function whose parameter decreases to zero.
